component.name: Nijiyome
component.summary: Anime player with libmpv and local extensions
Reproductor de anime con libmpv y extensiones locales

description.p: Nijiyome on the desktop: browse your library and history, sign in with AniList or MyAnimeList, play episodes with libmpv and Anime4K or FSR upscaling, stream torrents, download episodes, and run sideloaded .kai extensions in a sandboxed host. The same app runs on Android.
Two player modes are available in Settings:

ul.li: Embedded: libmpv drawn inside the app window, with the app controls.
External mpv: your own mpv in its own window, with your configuration, the enhanced mode (mpv-anime-build) and frame generation through lsfg-vk.

description.p: Nijiyome en el escritorio: explora tu biblioteca e historial, inicia sesión con AniList o MyAnimeList, reproduce episodios con libmpv y escalado Anime4K o FSR, mira torrents, descarga episodios y ejecuta extensiones .kai locales en un host aislado. La misma app funciona en Android.
First desktop build of Nijiyome (Kotlin Multiplatform): the Android app's screens on Linux and Windows.
